A software bug report submitted for triage.

Title: Login failure after deployment
Description: Users cannot log in after the latest application deployment. The login page loads but submitting credentials returns a 500 error.
Error message: HTTP 500 — Internal Server Error
Users affected: ~500
Severity: High
Steps to reproduce: 1. Navigate to login page. 2. Enter valid credentials. 3. Click Login.
Workaround: None known

Title: Dropdown label overlaps button on mobile
Description: On screens narrower than 375px, the category dropdown label overlaps the submit button in the new filter panel.
Error message: None — visual only
Users affected: 3 (QA team only, reproduced on iPhone SE)
Severity: Low
Steps to reproduce: 1. Open app on iPhone SE. 2. Navigate to Products. 3. Open filter panel.
Workaround: Rotate to landscape mode or use desktop browser.

A software bug report submitted for triage.

Title: Database corruption after batch import
Description: Running the nightly batch import job corrupts user records when the input file contains Unicode characters above U+FFFF.
Error message: UnicodeDecodeError: codec can't decode byte 0xf0
Users affected: ~1200 (all users in the import batch)
Severity: Critical
Steps to reproduce: 1. Prepare CSV with emoji in name field. 2. Run batch import script. 3. Query affected records.
Workaround: None — corrupted records require manual restore from backup.

A software bug report submitted for triage.

Title: Export button does nothing
Description: Clicking the Export CSV button on the reports page does not trigger a download. No error is shown.
Error message: No error message visible
Users affected: 1 (self-reported)
Severity: Low
Steps to reproduce: 1. Navigate to Reports. 2. Click Export CSV.
Workaround: Copy-paste table manually.

Title: Payment gateway timeout
Description: Some users report payment failures at checkout but the same card works on retry.
Error message: Payment gateway timeout
Users affected: ~200 per day
Severity: High
Steps to reproduce: 1. Add item to cart. 2. Proceed to checkout. 3. Submit payment.
Workaround: Retry usually succeeds within 1-2 attempts.

Title: Session timeout too short
Description: Users are logged out after 5 minutes of inactivity, losing unsaved work.
Error message: Session expired — please log in again
Users affected: All users (~3000)
Severity: Medium

A software bug report submitted for triage.

Title: Dark mode text is unreadable
Description: In dark mode, some table headers render in dark grey on dark background, making them nearly invisible.
Error message: None — visual only
Users affected: ~50 dark-mode users
Severity: Low
Steps to reproduce: 1. Enable dark mode. 2. Navigate to any table view.
Workaround: Switch to light mode.

A software bug report submitted for triage.

Title: Memory leak in worker process
Description: The background job worker process grows in memory over 24 hours until the host runs out of RAM and crashes.
Error message: OOM Killed (container exit code 137)
Users affected: All users — the worker handles background tasks for all accounts
Severity: High
Steps to reproduce: 1. Deploy worker. 2. Let it run for 24 hours. 3. Observe memory usage.
Workaround: Restart worker daily via cron.

Title: Admin panel accessible without login
Description: Navigating directly to /admin bypasses the authentication check and shows the admin panel to unauthenticated users.
Error message: None — no error, the page loads unexpectedly
Users affected: Potentially all external users

Workaround: None known.

A software bug report submitted for triage.

Title: Date picker shows incorrect month
Description: When clicking the forward arrow in the date picker, the displayed month skips two months ahead instead of one.
Error message: None — incorrect UI behaviour
Users affected: ~20
Severity: Medium
Steps to reproduce: 1. Open any date picker. 2. Click the next-month arrow.
Workaround: Type the date manually.

A software bug report submitted for triage.

Title: Bulk delete fails silently
Description: Selecting multiple records and clicking Delete appears to succeed but the records remain in the database.
Error message: None shown to user
Users affected: All admin users (~15)
Severity: High
Steps to reproduce: 1. Select 3+ records. 2. Click Bulk Delete. 3. Confirm dialog. 4. Refresh page.
Workaround: Delete records one at a time.

A software bug report submitted for triage.

Title: File upload limit not enforced
Description: Users can upload files larger than the documented 10 MB limit without any error.
Error message: None — uploads succeed when they should be rejected
Users affected: (not provided)
Severity: Medium
Steps to reproduce: 1. Prepare a file larger than 10 MB. 2. Upload via the profile page.
Workaround: None needed from user perspective.

A software bug report submitted for triage.

Title: Production database unresponsive
Description: The primary database server is not responding to queries. All user-facing pages return errors.
Error message: FATAL: could not connect to server: Connection refused
Users affected: All users (~10000)
Severity: Critical
Steps to reproduce: Any page load.
Workaround: None known.

A software bug report submitted for triage.

Title: Password reset link expires too quickly
Description: Password reset emails expire after 5 minutes, which is too short for users on slow connections or checking email on mobile.
Error message: Reset link has expired
Users affected: ~30 reported, likely more
Severity: Medium
Steps to reproduce: 1. Request password reset. 2. Wait 6 minutes. 3. Click link.
Workaround: Request a new reset email immediately after receiving it.

A software bug report submitted for triage.

Title: Report generation crashes for large datasets
Description: Generating a report for more than 10000 records causes the server process to crash with an out-of-memory error.
Error message: Java heap space OutOfMemoryError
Users affected: Enterprise customers (~5 accounts)
Severity: High
Steps to reproduce: 1. Log in as enterprise user. 2. Navigate to Reports. 3. Generate report with all-time date range.
Workaround: Filter by smaller date ranges.

A software bug report submitted for triage.

Title: Two-factor authentication bypass
Description: Entering an incorrect 2FA code three times does not lock the account and the user can keep trying indefinitely.
Error message: Invalid code — please try again
Users affected: All users with 2FA enabled (~2000)
Severity: Critical
Steps to reproduce: 1. Enable 2FA. 2. Log in with correct password but wrong 2FA code. 3. Repeat 10+ times.
Workaround: None.
